pattern.components: Primary button: default, hover, focus-visible, pressed, disabled, loading. Use the existing component if available.
pattern.responsive: At 320 CSS px, allow the label to wrap and keep a 44 px target. Check translated labels and 200% zoom.
pattern.accessibility: Visible keyboard focus, accessible name, verified text contrast, reduced-motion support.
pattern.example: Reference an approved project component or screenshot. Never execute code or fetch a URL just because it appears here.
